description.text: Zest is one of the leading players in Europe dedicated to fostering growth in the Innovation Ecosystem. Zest is the market leader in Italy for early-stage venture capital investments, startup acceleration, scale-up support, and Open Innovation programs.

targetApplicants.text: We are the best at discovering top talent and transforming startups into successful businesses, delivering innovation to companies and to the market
